people.name: Israel

people.name: Jerusalem

translations.web: Yahweh builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.
translations.bsb: The LORD builds up Jerusalem; He gathers the exiles of Israel.
translations.kjv: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
translations.asv: Jehovah doth build up Jerusalem; He gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
